title: A completed finite etale cover matching the principal quotient
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], f an element of its maximal ideal, U any open of Spec A [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and q:Y→U finite etale [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Write i:Spec(A/(f))→Spec A and V=i⁻¹(U). Suppose there is a finite etale r₀:F₀→Spec(A/(f)) and an isomorphism Y×_U V≅r₀⁻¹(V) over V [def-pc-fibre-product]. Put C equal to the maximal-ideal completion of A [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], c:Spec C→Spec A, W=c⁻¹(U), g the image of f in C, j:Spec(C/(g))→Spec C, and W₀=j⁻¹(W). There are a finite etale s:E→Spec C and an isomorphism (Y×_U W)×_W W₀≅s⁻¹(W)×_W W₀ over W₀. No punctured-spectrum or depth hypothesis is imposed, and no isomorphism over W is asserted.

proof.text: Put C = AdicCompletion(m_A,A). Apply lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-noetherian to get Noetherianity; Mathlib AdicCompletion.LocalRing gives its local-ring structure, maximal ideal m_C = m_A C, and m_C-adic completeness. For g, the image of f, the assumption f in m_A implies J=(g) is contained in m_C.

The proved private helper complete_subideal establishes J-adic completeness for every ideal J contained in the maximal ideal of a complete Noetherian local ring R. A J-adic Cauchy sequence is maximal-ideal-adically Cauchy and has a limit L. Fix n and put N=J^n R. The finite R-module R/N is maximal-ideal-adically Hausdorff by lem-weil-pbc-krull-intersection-jacobson, as packaged by Mathlib IsHausdorff. For each k, take l=max(n,k): the sequence residues at n and l agree modulo N, while the residue at l and L agree modulo m^k. Mapping the latter congruence into R/N proves that the residues at n and L agree modulo every m^k, hence are equal. Thus L has the prescribed residue modulo every J^n. J-adic separatedness follows from J^n contained in m^n. This applies also to J=0.

Construct the quotient map A/(f) to C/J with Ideal.quotientMap; its composite with A to A/(f) equals A to C to C/J. On spectra let k:Spec(C/J) to Spec(A/(f)), i and j the quotient inclusions, and c the completion morphism; then j followed by c equals k followed by i. Base change the supplied r0 along k. It is finite etale by base change stability. Apply lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-lifting-complete to C, J and the proper identity of Spec C, transporting Spec(C/J) to the chosen pullback of that identity and j. Obtain a finite etale s:E to Spec C. Transport its closed-fibre isomorphism back using pullback.map and cancellation of the canonical fibre isomorphism. This gives eg:pullback(s,j) isomorphic to pullback(r0,k), with eg.hom followed by the second projection equal to the second projection of pullback(s,j). Only essential surjectivity of the complete-base lifting input is used.

Put V=i inverse-image U, W=c inverse-image U, W0=j inverse-image W. The commuting square gives W0=k inverse-image V and a morphism v:W0 to V with v followed by the open inclusion equal to W0 inclusion followed by k. Cancellation of U inclusion gives (j restricted to W) followed by (c restricted to U) equal to v followed by (i restricted to U). Use pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso and pullback.congrHom to identify the left-hand double pullback with the base change along v of pullback(q,i restricted to U). The proved private helper base_change_iso base changes the supplied e0 to identify this with pullback(r0 restricted to V,v). The proved private helper restrict_pullback_iso, by horizontal pasting with isPullback_morphismRestrict, identifies the latter with pullback(r0,v followed by V inclusion). Rewrite by the equation for v, undo associativity, and base change eg inverse along W0 inclusion. Restore associativity and the restriction square for s and W to obtain pullback(s restricted to W,j restricted to W). Compose these isomorphisms. Each helper and each associativity isomorphism satisfies its second-projection equation; simplification of those equations proves exactly the required final projection equality. No depth, nonzero element or nonempty-open hypothesis is used.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_completed_cover_with_quotient_iso
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (f : A) (hf : f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite q] [Etale q]
    (hquot :
      let i := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f})))
      let V := i ⁻¹ᵁ U
      ∃ (F₀ : Scheme.{u}) (r₀ : F₀ ⟶ Spec (.of (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f}))),
        IsFinite r₀ ∧ Etale r₀ ∧
          ∃ e₀ : pullback q (i ∣_ U) ≅ (r₀ ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme,
            e₀.hom ≫ r₀ ∣_ V = pullback.snd q (i ∣_ U)) :
    let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let c := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A C))
    let W := c ⁻¹ᵁ U
    let j := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap A C f})))
    ∃ (E : Scheme.{u}) (s : E ⟶ Spec (.of C)), IsFinite s ∧ Etale s ∧
      ∃ e₀ : pullback (pullback.snd q (c ∣_ U)) (j ∣_ W) ≅
          pullback (s ∣_ W) (j ∣_ W),
        e₀.hom ≫ pullback.snd (s ∣_ W) (j ∣_ W) =
          pullback.snd (pullback.snd q (c ∣_ U)) (j ∣_ W)
